response.overview: High school is full of different experiences, but they all have one event in common: the downfall of their friend group. Leading into December, as winter break was approaching, Will fought with Henry, causing tensions to rise, ultimately dividing the friend group. Will, not wanting to back down, left the group alone. Time flies by as the final days of Winter Break begin, finishing up, and Chuck convinces the school's counselor to allow for an escape-the-school-type game in the hopes of bringing all his friends back together. Of course, reality isn't so easy.
response.title: The last reunion
